step_by_step_approach: Select all dismissal events that are credited to a bowler, ignoring run-outs and any dismissals not attributed to the bowler.
Count those events for each bowler to obtain the total number of wickets per bowler.
Collect the runs given up by each bowler, excluding wides, no-balls and other extra runs.
Sum the total balls bowled by each bowler.
Convert each bowler's total balls into overs (six balls per over).
Calculate the economy rate for each bowler by dividing the runs conceded by the overs bowled.
Calculate the strike rate for each bowler by dividing the balls bowled by the total wickets taken.
Determine the number of wickets each bowler took in each individual match.
Identify, for each bowler, the match where they recorded the highest wicket count.
For that match, combine the highest wicket count with the runs conceded (excluding extras) and format it as "wickets-runs" to represent the best bowling performance.
